name: Client Hint: platform version
plain: Exact operating system version, via a high-entropy Client Hint.
meaning: Only way left on Chromium to tell Windows 10 from 11 (major 13 or higher means 11) or macOS 14 from 15. Lets sites ship OS-specific features or target upgrade prompts.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: platformVersion
fields.range: Windows 0.x to 10.0.0 (Win10), 13.0.0 and up (Win11); macOS 10 to 26; Android 8 to 16

limits.headline: Can tell your exact Windows or macOS version when it asks
limits.user_action: Nothing. The site asks and Chromium answers without a prompt
can: Tell Windows 10 from Windows 11 (major 13 or higher means 11)
See your macOS or Android version
Turn on OS specific features or upgrade prompts
Use the version as a tracking clue
cannot: Work in Firefox, Safari, or on iPhone
See your patch level or install date
Get an answer until the site asks for it
See other apps on your system
limits.differs: Only Chromium browsers share it. Firefox and Safari do not.

story.what_it_is: Tells a site your exact operating system version, such as Windows 11 or macOS 15.

marketing.name: User-Agent Client Hints
marketing.pitch: Chrome's modern way for sites to ask for the exact platform version.

story.for_you: You never see it asked. It mainly helps a site avoid giving you features your system cannot run, or nudge you to update when you are far behind.
story.for_makers: On Chrome it is the only way left to tell Windows 10 from Windows 11. Makers use it to ship OS-specific features and to target upgrade messages. Security teams use it to spot old, risky systems.

use_cases.example: A web app uses the exact OS version to turn on Windows 11 window effects only where they work.
A browser game loads its WebGPU path only on OS versions that have a stable driver.
A streaming site picks the right DRM protection level for the operating system.
An IT dashboard in the browser highlights staff laptops still on an old OS version.
A bank shows a gentle update warning for visitors running an unsupported OS.
A software vendor targets users still on Windows 10 with a new PC promotion.

technical_bounds: macOS UA still says 10_15_7 so hint is the only truth

abuse: Version targeting for known OS exploits

history.change: UA string stopped carrying OS minor version; hint becomes sole source
